name: Enterprise V2 — multi-tenant portals, roles, consultant licensing, talent marketing
summary: Hostname tenancy, branded login-first portals, configurable multi-role permissions, base-license + feature add-on subscriptions, and the talent-marketing pipeline on the shared deployment. Design: docs/enterprise-v2/.

epics.name: Phase 0 — Audit, debate, foundation design, plan
epics.goal: The design set under docs/enterprise-v2 that every later phase builds from; 23 ADRs; escalations for the user.

epics.name: Phase 1 — Enterprise tenant foundation
epics.goal: Hostname → tenant resolution the client can never influence, tenant-bound sessions, roles as data, the invitation framework, and the negative-test gate — before any protected feature.

epics.name: Phase 2 — Branded login and dashboard shell
epics.goal: Runtime branding, one branded login, one enterprise shell with permission-driven workspaces, Org Admin lands on the Org Admin Dashboard, basic profile from the avatar menu, the Kiwiply character used compactly.

epics.name: Phase 3 — Custom domains
epics.goal: careers.acme.com: registration, ownership verification, on-demand certificates through the shared edge, activation, primary/redirect, suspension, removal, monitoring.

epics.name: Phase 4 — Roles, employees, departments, teams, assignments
epics.goal: Configurable role templates with a ceiling rule, employee lifecycle with bulk actions and audit, departments/teams, auditable consultant–marketer assignments.

epics.name: Phase 5 — Subscription foundation
epics.goal: Catalog (shared with personal plans), feature definitions and dependencies, base license + add-ons, pricing engine with contracts, entitlement evaluation, usage ledger, personal-subscription regression suite.

epics.name: Phase 6 — Billing and license UI, Stripe org billing
epics.goal: Subscription Overview, Consultant Licenses, Configure License with backend quotes, Billing & Invoices, Feature Usage, Platform Pricing Admin; one Stripe subscription per org; reconciliation.

epics.name: Phase 7 — Consultant and resume management
epics.goal: Consultant directory and profile overlay, org-managed resume links with approval and visibility, readiness, per-feature consent.

epics.name: Phase 8 — Talent marketing
epics.goal: Assigned talent, job discovery and AI matching for a consultant, opportunity assignment and authorization, follow-ups, activities, duplicate guard — the marketer prepares, never submits.

epics.name: Phase 9 — Consultant applications, interviews, extension workspace
epics.goal: Consultant workspace, assigned jobs, application link via submit-detect, interview coordination, AI interview prep (licensed), offers, extension workspace selector.

epics.name: Phase 10 — Clients and placements
epics.goal: Client accounts, contacts, vendor relationships, requirements, candidate submissions (records), offers, placements, extensions and redeployment, Account Manager workspace.

epics.name: Phase 11 — HR and Finance
epics.goal: Lifecycle records, compliance checklists and policy acknowledgements without identity documents; finance records over the Timesheets product; reports.

epics.name: Phase 12 — Advanced analytics and enterprise features
